title: Sean Payton shows he's still growing as an NFL coach by handing off play-calling | Opinion

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean Payton shows he's still growing as an NFL coach by handing off play-calling | Opinion
sources.description: Sean Payton, one of the NFL's great offensive minds, is giving new offensive coordinator Davis Webb the keys to the Broncos offense. It makes sense.
